hostParameters.label: Instrument
hostParameters.note: Host-automatable SFZ selection (issue #20). The choice list is machine-specific — ["(keep current)"] followed by every installed SFZ instrument — so the names are NOT listed here; the contract for mapping a name to a value is in instrumentSelect below.

instrumentSelect.samplesRoot: the shared Sapp 'samplesRoot' setting (SampleLibraries.settings, default ~/Samples); env SAPP_SFZ_ROOT overrides. CLI: `sappchoir sfz-index [--root DIR] [--rescan]` prints the exact entry/choice/normalized table.
instrumentSelect.order: entries[] are sorted case-insensitively by label (ASCII; ties by exact label, then path). The plugin re-sorts on load, so file order always equals choice order — never assume any other ordering.
instrumentSelect.nameToIndex: find the label in entries[] (label = path relative to the root, '/'-separated, without '.sfz'); its 0-based position i selects choice k = i + 1. Choice 0 = '(keep current)'. Normalized value for a host parameter write = k / count (the choice list has count + 1 items).
instrumentSelect.programChange: MIDI bank-select + program change also selects: entry = ((CC0 << 7) | CC32) * 128 + program. Any channel — SappChoir is single-timbral.
instrumentSelect.state: the chosen SFZ persists in host state BY ABSOLUTE PATH, not by index (indices shift when the library changes); a missing file at restore falls back to the built-in choir.
instrumentSelect.rescan: the choice list is fixed per plugin instantiation (JUCE cannot grow a choice list live); after adding libraries run `sappchoir sfz-index --rescan` (or delete the index) — the new list appears on the NEXT instantiation.
instrumentSelect.note: presets[] stays empty on purpose: the installed SFZ names are machine-specific, so this manifest carries the enumeration contract instead of a hardcoded list. The index file is SHARED with sapporchestra (same scan rules, same order).
